_comment: PRESET: coloring books & pages. Price bands are USD, from docs/research-findings-2026-11-23.md addendum §G (seller-tool live samples, directional — medians cluster at $2.99-4.45, so this is a bundle/volume business). Pricing block: digital, zero costs. THE AI RULE FOR THIS SHOP (Etsy Creativity Standards, updated 2025-06-10): seller-prompted AI creations ARE allowed when they come from YOUR original prompts AND the listing description discloses the AI use — this preset's brief sets ai_assisted so the generator adds the disclosure automatically. What is banned: selling AI prompt bundles, reselling PLR/MRR page packs as-is, and anyone else's pages. Human cleanup of every page (stray lines, broken shapes) is this shop's QC, not an Etsy rule — Etsy publishes no editing threshold.

Your buyers print at home — paper quality is their #1 complaint and your content angle.

materials: Digital file: printable PDF coloring book — no physical item ships

creation_path: Stage 3 research names ONE narrow theme (anxiety/self-care had ~3,887 competing listings vs ~541K for 'coloring pages', tool data) and scores it
Write the page briefs: 40-100 pages, one theme, consistent line weight and style — your prompts/art direction, recorded per page

Produce the pages: your own line art, or seller-prompted AI from your briefs, then human-clean EVERY page (broken lines and stray artefacts are the #1 review complaint); AI use goes in the description — the generator adds the disclosure line
Assemble and print-test: PDF at print size, test-print 5+ pages on a home printer, check margins and line darkness; file <=20 MB (Stage 4/5)

Generate the listing pack with pipeline/listing.py (Stage 6) — categorise as 'Designed by a seller', never handmade; publish gate (Stage 7); the same pages may ALSO become a KDP paperback later (separate platform, separate AI disclosure at publish)
delivery: Instant download of a printable PDF — buyers print at home. Optional later lane: the same original pages as a print paperback via KDP (not Etsy, not Printify)
launch_checklist: Stage 1: intake answered — existing shop health-checked (Etsy Payments active, bank verified, shop policies set); no shop yet → appendix walkthrough first (docs/appendix-shop-creation.md)
Stage 2: SKIPPED — no Printify for downloads; note it and move on
Stage 3: one narrow theme scored with pipeline/scoring.py; broad 'coloring pages' fails competition by default (~541K listings, tool data)
Stage 4: every page human-cleaned and print-tested; line weight consistent; NO franchise characters or copied pages (the IP gate); AI prompts are yours and logged
Stage 5: price with the calculator at zero cost; the themed BUNDLE is the product — single cheap packs are review-builders in a $3-5 median market
Stage 6: listing pack generated WITH the AI disclosure line in the description (Etsy requires it); listed as 'Designed by a seller'; licence terms stated
Stage 7: human approves the exact PDF + pack; publish as a Digital listing; read back and test-download/print
Stage 8: watch print-quality complaints as defect reports; seasonal packs listed 6-8 weeks ahead (Halloween/Christmas carry this category); weekly review

summary: Printable coloring books and page packs in narrow themes, sold as instant-download PDFs. Research verdict (2026-11-23, addendum §G): a crowded, cheap category — ~541K 'coloring pages' listings with medians of $2.99-4.45 (tool data) — where narrow themes (anxiety/self-care: ~3.9K listings) and bold-and-easy cozy books are the working entry, and bundles are the only real margin. AI is allowed here under Etsy's actual rule: your original prompts + disclosure in the description + 'Designed by a seller'. PLR mega-bundles resold as-is are the category's trap and fail the original-design rule.
